LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P1.Title: 1. Slot machine
LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P1.Body:
A lever, three reels that already know the answer, and a machine with a long memory: your tokens are kept between visits, saved with the colony.
The reels wear the classic faces, rimworld edition - lucky sevens, gold, BAR, strawberries, and where the lemons used to be, skulls. The house spots a new colony twenty tokens; after that, 200 silver buys 20 more. Silver goes in. It does not come back out. This is the one thing in the rec room where skill will not help you.
See how tall the stack gets before the machine wins. The machine always wins.
LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P2.Title: 2. Paytable
LanguageData.SLT.Tut.P2.Body:
A pull costs one token. Three of a kind pays - sevens best, skulls least - and a pair of sevens gets you a consolation.
Rumor has it the machine remembers whoever stacks a thousand.
That is the whole rulebook. Pull.
